No contradictory evidence (e.g., symptoms, imaging, lab abnormalities) suggests an alternative diagnosis (e.g., serrated polyposis, Lynch-related lesion, or invasive carcinoma). Thus, despite missing size/margins, the diagnosis is *clinically sufficient and definitive at this stage*.
